name: Hubert ohne Staller
description: A show about two Bavarian police officers, Franz Hubert and Johannes Staller, who sometimes work a bit differently. Where Franz wants to follow regulations, Johannes likes to do things his own way.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hubert and Staller actually only want to catch an escaped parrot, but then discover that the bird's owner has passed away.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Bringing rowdy youths to heel at the suburban train station sounds like a routine job until Staller suddenly finds himself standing in a pool of blood in the public restroom.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: According to Staller, contract killings in old people's homes are generally quite rare. But senior citizen Hannelore Kramer is convinced that someone wants to send her to the afterlife.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Helping a friendly young woman who’s slipped into a ditch with her tractor? Of course. And also help her search for her runaway dog.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A complaint from hotel guests leads Hubert and Staller to farmer Wildmoser's farm. The squealing of his pigs is too loud. But that's not the only noise.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: During a routine outing, Hubert and Staller discover a dead body with bruises and a cut on the shore of Lake Starnberg. Accident or murder?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Holger Döhla wants to pick up his car after it has been towed away. But when he hands it over, he notices that the car is leaking fluid: Blood.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Instead of an egg thief plundering swans' nests, Hubert and Staller find the body of an art dealer floating in the water next to a rowing boat.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Hubert and Staller are ordered to investigate a missing person's report immediately. The fact that less than 24 hours have passed proves the explosive nature of the case.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: An anonymous tip-off about swine fever leads to farmer Hartmann's farm. But instead of infected animals, Hubert and Staller only find the farm owner himself - murdered.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: In a burned-down cabin, Hubert and Staller find the remains of a corpse. Has the owner fallen victim to insurance fraud? However, he is very much alive.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A purse snatcher trips over the legs of a man on a park bench while fleeing. Hubert wants to thank him for the help, but the man who caused the trip is dead.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: A straightforward case of "causing a public nuisance" involving a scantily clad woman takes a back seat when a woman's body is found in a haystack.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Staller accidentally shoots a deer. To avoid making headlines as a trigger-happy police officer, he spontaneously makes up a story about poachers.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: A young woman is found lifeless on a park bench. According to the initial assessment by the medical examiner, a drug cocktail was the cause of her death.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Hubert and Staller are called to break up a disturbance. In the process, some of the bystanders make a horrifying discovery: the local antiques dealer is found dead in the water.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The only car for miles speeds through a traffic checkpoint without braking, flies off the next curve, and overturns. The victim: a sober doctor.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Hubert and Staller are supposed to teach children proper behavior in traffic. But then, teacher Beck is found dead, and teacher Sommer is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Staller finds a baked-in finger in his bread roll… but Police Councilor Girwidz sees the current dog infestation as a much bigger problem.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The dead owner of a casino is found during the obligatory official sport. During the investigation, Staller's luck doesn't just seem to be in the game.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: During a night-time operation, Staller not only puts burglars to flight, but also damages a house wall. In the process, he discovers the walled-in skeleton of a woman.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In the rehearsal room of the local brass band, Peter Händel is found headfirst in the bell of a tuba with a crushed skull. A trumpet was the murder weapon.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: An architect was beaten to death with one of his model houses. The only clue is an “8” that the dying man smeared on the window with his own blood.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: An elderly woman has been murdered—suffocated on dry cake. A case involving a senior living community, a newspaper article, and an unclaimed lottery ticket.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A dead man in a boat was killed by a package of cocaine weighing several kilos. A tracking device on the body and a transmitter on the package suggest an interception operation.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Hubert and Staller respond to an emergency call and find a man lying motionless by the side of the road. Just as Hubert is about to call the pathologist, the "dead" man suddenly gets up.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: A man is found floating lifeless in the water. Since the deceased is wearing a T-shirt from the local water rescue service and was likely a very good swimmer, the case seems mysterious.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Sculptor and painter Nobo Grün was bludgeoned to death with his own sculpture. What initially appears to be a robbery-murder gradually takes on more and more color as the case unfolds.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: While Hubert and Staller investigate a break-in at the scrapyard, a suspicious red liquid drips from a vehicle that has just come out of the car crusher.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: While Staller finds a bathrobe belt blocking the pedals of a pedal boat, Hubert discovers the matching bathrobe—on a waterlogged corpse.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: A scream shatters the peaceful "Omm" from a seminar center. The personality coach Gerber has collapsed dead because he didn't take his medication.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Hubert and Staller are tasked with getting change for a sausage stand at the bank, but they quickly find themselves caught up in a bank robbery that escalates into a hostage situation.

videos.title: A woman for certain hours
videos.overview: Hubert and Girwidz observe a woman attempting to enter the home of architect Nicole Jansen. The woman claims to have an appointment and that the doorbell is broken. Inside the house, Hubert and Girwidz discover that the architect would not have been able to open the door anyway. She has been shot with a crossbow bolt. There is much to suggest that her husband is the perpetrator, but Robert Jansen has a solid alibi...

videos.title: Death by prescription
videos.overview: Girwidz discovers the body of general practitioner Dr. Volker Imhoff in a toilet. Everything points to death by hypoglycemia due to his diabetes. But when Dr. Fuchs takes a closer look at the dead man and examines his insulin cannula, she finds traces of tampering. Apparently, Imhoff's killer increased the insulin concentration, leading to an overdose...

videos.title: The missing corpse
videos.overview: Hubert and Girwidz receive an emergency call from Dr. Fuchs: a corpse has disappeared from the pathology department. Hubert believes it is a patient who is only apparently dead, and Girwidz searches the clinic half-heartedly. But the missing corpse happens to be the father of state parliament representative Elke Schwiers, who has been pushing for the privatization of the clinic and thus the closure of the pathology department for years...

videos.title: Teachers are only human
videos.overview: Hubert and Girwidz find a cyclist who has been killed in an accident. They identify her as a math teacher at Wolfratshausen Comprehensive School. But while Hubert drives to the school to deliver the sad news, Dr. Fuchs refutes the accident theory. She discovers that a wire was stretched across the road. The supposed accident was actually cold-blooded murder...

videos.title: Game Set Coffin
videos.overview: Christina has an appointment for a trial tennis lesson—and finds the tennis instructor dead on the court, beaten to death with his own tennis racket. Club chairman Bernhard Seibel, who is primarily interested in advancing his daughter Patricia's tennis career, reports that the victim had no enemies and suspects revenge by a cuckolded husband...

videos.title: The Last Supper
videos.overview: While searching for Wilderen, Hubert and Girwidz stumble across the body of farmer Thomas Lengstätter. The investigators find no evidence of foul play and assume that the cause of death was natural. However, pathologist Caronline Fuchs comes to a different conclusion. She suspects that Lengstätter may have been the victim of a particularly perfidious murder...

videos.title: Puppy protection
videos.overview: While on patrol, Hubert and Riedl discover the body of wildlife photographer Axel Kämmer. What initially appears to be a hit-and-run accident turns out to be premeditated murder after Dr. Fuchs' autopsy. Kämmer was apparently beaten to death and then run over by a car. Hubert wonders why the victim met with the perpetrator on a remote country road.

videos.title: Guide to Happiness
videos.overview: Hubert and Girwidz discover a corpse rolled up in a carpet on the riverbank. The victim, Johannes Graf, had been reported missing by his wife that morning after he failed to return from a hike in the mountains. It quickly becomes clear that Mr. Graf, who had recently changed his life after consulting a life coach, was not in the mountains at all...

videos.title: The taste of chrome and leather
videos.overview: Hubert and Girwidz just want to return little Fabian's soccer ball, which rolled into a stranger's garage. But the garage contains not only the ball, but also the body of real estate agent Thorsten Falk. Mr. Falk's motorcycle, on the other hand, has disappeared without a trace. He enjoyed riding out into nature with others in his free time—including on the day he was murdered...

videos.title: The big coup
videos.overview: Hubert and Girwidz buy ice cream from Yazid, who has expanded his business to include an ice cream truck. While the police officers are ordering their ice cream, security guard Gerhard Feinbein is knocked down behind their backs by a masked and armed person, who immediately hijacks a cash transport vehicle, whose crew includes driver Maximilian Steimle and Feinbein.

videos.title: Pizza Morte
videos.overview: Hubert and Girwidz find the body of a young woman on a bench on the shore of Lake Starnberg. Based on her company car, Hubert and Girwidz believe they are dealing with the owner of a start-up that specializes in the production of high-quality frozen pizzas. But when they visit the start-up, they discover that the supposed victim is very much alive...

videos.title: Smile, please
videos.overview: The operator of a private Bitcoin exchange is found hanged on his terrace. With a massive price slump dominating the headlines, there is initially no doubt that it was suicide. Only the discovery of a USB stick in the dead man's throat and the results of the autopsy point to foul play. Hubert and Girwidz suspect the branch manager of a bank...

videos.title: The art of breaking and entering
videos.overview: The police are hot on the heels of a cunning gang of burglars who have been wreaking havoc in Wolfratshausen's high society for some time. They mainly steal valuable paintings without leaving any traces behind. This makes the case almost impossible for Hubert and Girwidz to solve. But then Hubert discovers that all the stolen paintings were purchased from the same gallery...

videos.title: On behalf of the devil
videos.overview: Riedl is buying doughnuts at the Rattlinger bakery when a confused woman with blood on her clothes appears. However, she is unharmed, and the blood is not hers. She is Magdalena Meier, who has escaped from a secure psychiatric ward. When Hubert and Girwidz bring the woman back, they find the clinic in a state of shock: a nurse has been murdered...

videos.title: An unidentified corpse
videos.overview: Because a witness failed to appear at the police station despite being summoned, Hubert and Girwidz want to search for the man. Too late—he is found dead in the sewage tank, his workplace. Sewage treatment plant manager Ulrike Mettmann assumes it was a tragic accident. But it quickly becomes clear that someone helped him along. When it also turns out that the tap water is contaminated, a state of emergency is declared in Wolfratshausen. For Hubert, however, this warning comes too late. He has already drunk the contaminated water...

videos.title: The Dead Man in the Boiler Room
videos.overview: District chief Sabine Kaiser's lease is being terminated. She visits a small house where she discovers the body of a man in the boiler room. When Hubert and Girwidz begin their investigation, the dead man turns out to be the “vacancy manager” for the Hinterholzer real estate agency. Pathologist Dr. Fuchs determines that the man died of a heart attack as a result of a panic attack...

videos.title: Confession from the future
videos.overview: At the Rattlinger bakery, Yazid finds a suicide note in which Mr. Lauber announces his intention to murder his wife and then commit suicide. Hubert and Girwidz are relieved to find the couple alive. Lauber also claims that he did not write the note. Pathologist Fuchs determines that the suicide note was indeed written by Lauber...

videos.title: cock of the walk
videos.overview: Hubert and Girwidz are called to a country hotel to calm down an angry guest. Then a chambermaid screams when she discovers the body of a young woman with a gaping head wound. Hubert and Girwidz find out that the apartment of the dead Rebecca Lang is just around the corner, and they also discover her positive pregnancy test. Both findings raise questions...

videos.title: To the stars
videos.overview: Karsten Heimreich has a brilliant business idea: he creates a bike tour that passes by the villas of celebrities on Lake Starnberg. His business partner is Yazid, who provides him with the addresses. The semi-legal tour is very popular with tourists. The celebrities affected feel quite differently. When Heimreich is found murdered, Hubert and Girwidz have a suspicion...

videos.title: killer risotto
videos.overview: Instead of showing off his new cooking diploma, “Doctor Risotto,” to his colleagues in the morning, Girwidz has to investigate a complaint with Hubert. A customer at Café Rattlinger feels discriminated against—by Yazid, of all people. When the two police officers arrive, the caller is dead. It is Prince Meinolf XIII of Entenbach, who had been banned from the bakery.

videos.title: When the music plays
videos.overview: Musician Siggi Prechtl comes to the police station and confesses to murder: after a joint performance on an excursion steamer, he pushed his twin brother Paul into Lake Starnberg out of jealousy. But when the police find the body, nothing adds up: Paul Prechtl did not drown, and could not have been washed up at the site where he was found...

videos.title: The Night Elvis Died
videos.overview: Dr. Fuchs had a wild time at a beach party thrown by the volunteer fire department. The next morning, the pathologist has a rude awakening: she finds the body of a fellow firefighter buried in the sand, who had already been reported missing by his wife. Hubert persuades Dr. Fuchs to ask around among her firefighter acquaintances...

videos.title: A little piece of paradise
videos.overview: While inspecting a construction site, Girwidz stumbles across a finger encased in concrete. Someone has encased the body of an employee from the building department in concrete. He was supposed to check whether Julia Dreier had violated hygiene regulations on her property. The police find out that the woman has been engaged in a long-running feud with her neighbor Otto Sternhagen...

videos.title: Restless rest
videos.overview: Immediately after returning from vacation, Girwidz and Hubert come across a hiking boot. Inside is a severed foot. Was a murder victim disposed of piece by piece? Or does the foot belong to Christoph Brammer, who has recently gone missing? Hubert and Girwidz begin their investigation and track down a funeral director with a shady past. ..

videos.title: Wer schön sein will, muss leiden
